**Finding: Compliant** (no redline)

The governing law and venue provisions sit in the General Provisions block at §(a):

- **Governing law (p0145):** internal laws of the State of New York, U.S.A., without regard to conflict of law principles — our preferred jurisdiction.
- **Venue (p0146):** suits must be instituted in the City of New York; both parties irrevocably submit to the **exclusive** jurisdiction of the SDNY or any New York State court, and waive venue and forum non conveniens objections.
- **Arbitration:** a document-wide search returned no arbitration provision, so disputes are resolved in court — no offshore seat risk.

This lands squarely on the preferred position (New York law + exclusive New York courts). The clause says "City of New York" rather than "New York County"; that is an immaterial variance noted for the record only — the SDNY sits in New York County regardless — and per the playbook it is not flagged as a deviation. The clause is also mutual, binding Licensor equally, so nothing here operates against us.
